extracted.name: Bakery-Style Chocolate Chip Cookies 🍪
extracted.description: Looking for a no-fail chocolate chip cookie recipe that’s simple to make and tastes like it came straight from a bakery? This one delivers every time - easy, reliable, and consistently delicious. #march2027 #cookies #chocolatechip
ingredient_lines: 1 tsp Baking soda (Alternatively you can do 1 tsp of Baking powder however they will be more puffy than flat and chewy)
227 g (2 sticks) Unsalted butter, at room temperature (67°F)
1 1/4 cups (247 g) Light brown sugar, lightly packed
2 cups (340 g) Semisweet chocolate chips (1 bag of Nestle chocolate chips preferred)
instruction_lines: Whisk flour, baking soda, and salt in a bowl.
Beat butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until creamy. (I used a stand-mixer for this.)
Add eggs and vanilla, mixing until combined.
Gradually add dry ingredients to wet mixture.
Bake for 10–12 minutes until golden at edges.
